## canvas
- viewBox: 0 0 1280 720
- format: PPT 16:9

## mode
- mode: pyramid

## visual_style
- visual_style: data-journalism

## colors
- background: #F5F7FB
- secondary_background: #F9FAFD
- primary: #4A66AC
- accent: #4A66AC
- secondary_accent: #84BB1E
- body_text: #08194A
- secondary_text: #626D8D
- divider: #D8DEE8

## typography
- title_family: "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
- body_family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
- font_family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
- display: 49
- title: 38
- metric: 34
- subtitle: 23
- body: 20
- annotation: 12

## icons
- library: tabler-outline
- inventory: book-2, sparkles, users, chart-bar, alert-triangle, target-arrow
- stroke_width: 1.5

## pptx_structure
- mode: flat
